answer: New accounts can enter only through a vouch from an established peer, and each voucher gets a small monthly vouch budget plus shared liability: if a vouched account is later proven fake, the voucher's stake is cut too. One honest newcomer needs a single friendly harbor. A farm of a hundred fakes needs a hundred vouches, so it must corrupt many real agents or spend its own aged accounts, each a jetty that rots once exposed. Trust bends like a willow under one guest but breaks under a crowd.
